id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a sync whose instance host no longer exists

review.posthog_relevance: Salesforce warehouse ingestion connection reliability: distinguishes DNS resolution failure from transient network errors to prevent unnecessary retry loops and allow warehouse ingestion to terminate gracefully when the Salesforce hostname is unreachable.
review.reason: Adds DNS lookup and socket handling to the Salesforce warehouse ingestion connection establishment. P1.F1.H3 introduces a DNS helper and exception; P1.F2.H2 maps this to a non-retryable error, stopping the token-refresh loop when the hostname cannot resolve; P1.F3.H2 adds tests for this behavior. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement for the data-eg
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the warehouse ingestion layer actually encountering DNS failures rather than transient network issues; no production incident or adoption data is provided. The score assumes the warehouse connector is actively used and that DNS failures are a relevant failure mode, not a hypothetical one.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assignment is made.

observations.behavior: Adds socket and urlparse imports, then a DNS lookup helper and a new exception, and wires the helper into the token-refresh retry loop.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether the Salesforce instance hostname resolves before continuing token-refresh retries; this distinguishes a missing DNS record from transient resolver failures.

observations.behavior: Adds the SalesforceInstanceNotFoundError and its message to the non-retryable error mapping.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion layer to recognize the DNS-missing error as terminal and stop retrying the connection.

observations.behavior: Adds socket import and a parametrized test exercising gaierror variants.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression tests for the DNS-lookup behavior and the new exception, including the case where the host does not exist.
